notes: Reached ES storefront via the Akamai interstitial proof-of-work solver (curl_cffi chrome-impersonation session, POST /_sec/verify?provider=interstitial), same method validated on sibling stores GB (SR90) and DE (SR106). Checked: (1) the full mega-menu tree embedded as JSON in the homepage's serverApp-state, (2) the same tree re-confirmed on a second page (novedades-coleccion-n942), (3) robots.txt (5840 bytes, no Claude/anthropic-ai-named disallow, matches prior Home-Decor pass finding), (4) the site's own ES category sitemap (https://www.zarahome.com/8/info/sitemaps/sitemap-home-categories-zh-es-0.xml.gz, 1670 URLs, full-text scanned for 'vendid'/'popular'/'top-sell'/'trend' substrings -- zero hits). No standalone Bestsellers PLP exists anywhere on the ES storefront. The menu-tree JSON contains exactly ONE entry with canonicalName='BESTSELLERS' (key E-I-A_F_BESTSELLERS_COSMETICA, seo.keyword='fragancias', seoId 1057) -- narrower than GB's 7 department-level Bestsellers widgets, but the same non-genuine pattern: content.type='grid' (an in-page curated widget/celement, id 1020466446), seoExtraInfo.irrelevant=true, resolving through its seoId to the Fragrances department's own general landing page rather than a separate filterable listing with its own URL or product count. This is not present as a standalone entry anywhere in the ES sitemap. No /mas-vendidos, /populares, /rebajas-vendidos, /best-sellers, /bestsellers, or equivalent standalone path exists in nav or sitemap. Concluding no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on Zara Home ES, consistent with the GB and DE sibling findings.
